The latest landing we heard about was published in O MUNICÍPIO on 27/04/1996, reporting research by ufologist and professor Francisco Donizetti Varanda.
On 9 April 1996, around 19:30, a UFO appeared among trees forming a boundary row and landed on pasture beside a barbed-wire fence.
Six nearby residents witnessed it at Bairro dos Campinhos, on the boundary between Águas da Prata and São Sebastião da Grama, SP.
The UFO emitted an intense reddish light varying between violet and pink.
